Text: Shedding season hits #pets with fur and pets with scales. What's the worst shed you've dealt with?
Comment(s): Fur people, a double coat blowing out counts. Scale people, a stuck eye cap counts double.

Text: Velvet #worms hunt with glue. Two slime jets fire from nozzles by the head, reach a foot out, and set in seconds.
Comment(s): The body plan has barely changed in hundreds of millions of years, about as close to a living fossil as anything alive.

Text: #Pets are cheap until they aren't. The most you've spent at the vet in one visit, and was it worth it?
Comment(s): For scale: a routine exotic vet checkup for a tortoise runs around $75, and an illness that needs tests or medication commonly runs $150 to $300 or more.

Text: #Pets and the furniture: allowed, not allowed, or 'not allowed' but currently on the couch?
Comment(s): Most houses run the same system. The pet decides, the human ratifies.

Text: The Gaboon #viper bites and holds on. Most vipers inject and let go, then track the prey. This one keeps hold where it struck.
Comment(s): Holding on is also what makes a bite on a person so much worse than the fang length alone suggests.

Text: Bath day. Does your #pet tolerate it, enjoy it, or treat it as a betrayal?
Comment(s): Chinchillas get a dust bath instead of water, and for them it is the best part of the week.

Text: The part of caring for your #pet nobody warned you about. Not the cost, the thing you actually didn't see coming.
Comment(s): Ours: how much of exotic pet care is managing humidity. Nobody mentions the hygrometer.

Text: I assumed a captive poison dart #frog was still dangerous. It is not. The poison comes from wild mites and ants, and a frog raised on fruit flies never gets it.
Comment(s): Wild-caught is a completely different proposition, which is the whole reason captive-bred matters here.

Text: Every #pet has a nemesis. The vacuum, the mail carrier, one specific squirrel. Who is your pet's?
Comment(s): A hognose snake's answer to any enemy is to hiss, hood up, and then play dead with its tongue out.

Text: Some #pets pick their person and it's never who paid for them. Who does your pet actually belong to?
Comment(s): Lovebirds pick one person and bond intensely. Budgies spread it around the whole flock.

Text: #Pangolins have no teeth. The stomach chews instead: muscular, lined with keratin spines pointing inward, and usually holding swallowed stones.
Comment(s): The scales are keratin too, fingernail protein, and they made up 99 percent of every confiscated pangolin part in seizures logged from 2016 to 2024.

Text: Most expensive thing your #pet has destroyed. Charger cables don't count, everyone has lost those.
Comment(s): Ferrets keep it cheap and dangerous. Rubber and foam items, chewed and swallowed, are a real blockage risk, not a minor one.

Text: The sound your #pet makes that nobody believes until they hear it. Describe it, badly.
Comment(s): A male red-footed tortoise clucks like a chicken during courtship. Nobody believes that one either.

Text: Constriction is about blood, not bones. A big #anaconda squeezes hard enough to stop circulation, and that kills far faster than suffocation.
Comment(s): It tightens as the prey breathes out, so every exhale gives up room it never gets back.

Text: What is your #pet irrationally afraid of? Bonus points if it's smaller than them.
Comment(s): Hedgehogs startle at sudden movement, not at what they see. They see poorly and run on smell and hearing.

Text: The dumbest thing your #pet has done this week. Not ever, this week. There's always one.
Comment(s): A hognose flipped right side up in the middle of playing dead will roll itself back over, as if you had not noticed.

Text: Amano #shrimp are born needing salt water and die from it as adults. Larvae must reach brackish water within days. A grown one dies from a small accidental dose.
Comment(s): Trying to acclimate an adult into a saltwater tank kills it. The salt phase belongs to the larvae only.

Text: Tortoise people will win this one, but go anyway: the oldest #pet you've ever had, and how old it got.
Comment(s): A well-kept Russian tortoise can pass 40 years, some 50 or beyond, at five to nine inches long.

Text: Weirdest thing your #pet eats on purpose. Not stole once, eats, as a habit.
Comment(s): Degus eat their own droppings on purpose. It is a nutritional requirement, not a habit to break.

Text: Both parents make milk. A Victoria crowned #pigeon chick lives on crop milk alone for its first days, from the male and the female. No lactose, same job.
Comment(s): Pairs raise a single chick, and both sit the egg: the male through the day, the female overnight. The bird is about 75 cm long and up to 2.5 kg.

Text: #Pets and closed doors. Does yours follow you into the bathroom, wait outside, or scream?
Comment(s): Ferrets are the bathroom-door answer. They need hours of supervised time out of the cage every day and will find the one gap you missed.
